category: maps, routing, geocoding and search API

free_tier.stated: Base plan, with a payment method on file: 30,000 Geocode and Reverse Geocode transactions a month and 30,000 car, bicycle or pedestrian routing transactions a month free, 5,000 Discover/Search and 5,000 Autosuggest a month free; 1 transaction for every request; no daily transaction limits
free_tier.notes: above the free amount geocoding is USD 0.88 per 1,000 up to 5,000,000 a month; the no-card Limited plan closed to new customers in March 2025 and was retired on August 31, 2025

per_object_cap.stated: no batch geocoding on the Base plan: HERE Batch API v7 (up to 1 Million records a job) is not included in the Base plan

retention.stated: longer storage needs a Permanent Storage Plan, and Permanent Geocoding is not included in the Base plan

egress.terms: not applicable: a query API metered in transactions, not bytes

interface_detail: HTTPS to geocode.search.hereapi.com/v1/geocode and the other HERE REST APIs with an API key of an app ID; a keyless geocode answered HTTP 401 'No credentials found'; rate limits exist on every endpoint but their sizes are not published
tooling: any HTTP client; HERE Maps API for JavaScript and the HERE Explore SDK
chaining: 30,000 geocodes and 30,000 car, bicycle or pedestrian routes a month behind a card on file, results kept at most 30 days; overage is billed per transaction rather than refused, and the Batch API is outside the Base plan, so the bulk path is single requests

limits.value: 30,000 Geocode and Reverse Geocode transactions a month free, then USD 0.88 per 1,000
rate limits on all endpoints, sizes not disclosed
geocoding results stored outside the platform for at most 30 days

binding_note: past 30,000 geocodes a month the plan bills each 1,000 rather than refusing, so the free monthly amount is the first limit met

identity_cost.detail: the Base plan requires entering a payment method during onboarding; nothing is charged below the free monthly amounts. The no-card Limited plan is retired

reliability_note: usage above the free amounts is billed to the payment method, with no daily transaction limit; one app ID serves one application only
confidence_note: the pricing page and its calculator data, the Base plan restrictions, the April and July 2025 release notes, the sign-up page, the Permanent Geocoding knowledge-base article and the Geocoding and Search limits and Batch API docs were quoted on 2026-10-31; a keyless geocode answered HTTP 401. No account was opened; the rate limit sizes are behind a sign-up.
